meta.name: seo-technical-audit
meta.description: Focused one-shot technical SEO audit for a domain. Crawlability, indexability, security, mobile, structured data, JS rendering — single-pass deliverable, not a diff. Distinct from `seo-drift` (which tracks changes over time) and from `seo-page` (which audits keywords/traffic for one URL, not technical health). Use when the user asks "technical audit", "site audit", "audit my site", "crawl issues", "indexation issues", or "technical SEO check".
